ValidationRule.description: DEACTIVATED 2026-06-22 (Cyril; notify Alosh). RDD now enforced in Quote_Screen_SubmitForReview flow. VR only fired on direct Draft->In Review change, which submit never does. Kept for re-enable.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Draft'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'In Review'), ISBLANK(RDD__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Requested Delivery Date is required before submitting this quote for review. Please set the RDD, then submit.
